sn48.55:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci sāragandhā, lohitacandanaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.55:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhikā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ bodhāya.
sn48.55:1.4: saddhindriyaṃ bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiko dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
sn48.55:1.8: paññindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiko dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
sn48.55:1.9: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci sāragandhā, lohitacandanaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.55:1.10: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ
